sites.description: The region’s main settlement: a wealthy Ilyran centre of grain, craft, pilgrimage and controlled prosperity.
A large, dangerous settlement controlled by a hidden syndicate and known for gathering restricted artefacts.
A holy settlement at the forest threshold, dominated by the monument and temple of the Hero of Mercy.
A magically attuned and highly pious town where weapons and magical implements are peacebound or surrendered.
A supposed utopian council where political voice is effectively limited to landowning Ilyran faithful.
A tiny forest-edge habitation on the old adventuring trail leading toward the buried Fifth-God ruin.
A therapeutic village of hospitals, retreats, healing herbs and a renowned necropolis.
A pious but lawless village whose Ilyran devotion has not produced stable civil authority.
A tightly secured noble settlement whose moral laws prohibit common vices while luxury trade serves a resident dynasty.
A pious and superstitious lakeside village surrounded by fields, fisheries and wetland holdings.
An impoverished and isolated village centred on an Ilyran monastic order.
A livestock and mount-breeding village known for excellent animals and hostility toward non-humans.
A tiny magically attuned hamlet embedded within the forest near converging old powers.
An isolated village fiercely loyal to its own people and known for a regional carnival.
